description: This file defines a generic, re-usable histogram class 'NumericHistogram' supporting partial aggregations, including methods for merging histograms, adding data points, and trimming bins. It also contains a nested 'Coord' class representing histogram bins.

classes.name: NumericHistogram
classes.description: A class implementing a streaming, heuristic-based histogram with support for partial aggregation and bin merging.

classes.name: NumericHistogram.Coord
classes.description: A nested class representing a histogram bin as an (x,y) pair, with comparison based on 'x'.

methods.name: getNumBins
methods.description: Returns the total number of bins in the histogram.

methods.name: getUsedBins
methods.description: Returns the number of bins currently used.

methods.name: setUsedBins
methods.description: Sets the number of used bins.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the histogram has been initialized via merge() or allocate().

methods.name: getBin
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bin by index.

methods.name: addBin
methods.description: Adds a bin with specified x and y values at a given index.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Initializes the histogram with a specified number of bins.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another NumericHistogram into this one, combining bins.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a data point to the histogram, updating bins accordingly.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Reduces the number of bins to the target count by merging closest bins.
